purpose: Source caveats found while mining, not silent corrections to official files. Original sources remain unchanged.

flags.issue: The 2022 P3 question paper repeats (i) on PDF page 9; the report renumbers the following tasks. The 2024 P2 report also shifts Q3(a) and Q5(a) references.
flags.handling: Explicit question-demand crosswalk preserves original refs and unique marked occurrences; no extra parts added.
flags.status: recorded; do not propagate unverified source wording into learner material

flags.issue: 2024 P2 Q1(a)(iv): QP names spot height 65; report names 56, and offers bearing 245 (243–247) as well as 218–222.
flags.handling: Retain the demand/skill only; independently measure the correct map endpoints before any worked answer. No disputed numeric answer authored.
flags.status: recorded; do not propagate unverified source wording into learner material

flags.issue: 2020 P2 report says solar cannot power colour TVs or kitchens in the specific energy-supply case.
flags.handling: Teach constraints of the specified system/capacity, not a universal prohibition on solar powering these loads.
flags.status: recorded; do not propagate unverified source wording into learner material

flags.issue: 2023 P1 report includes damage to the ozone layer among effects associated with the coal power-station task.
flags.handling: Do not derive an ozone/greenhouse mechanism from this list alone. Check an appropriate primary scientific source when authoring.
flags.status: recorded; do not propagate unverified source wording into learner material

flags.issue: 2022 P1 Q2(a)(ii) has two marks but report lists three separate one-mark stages for determining humidity.
flags.handling: Record the required method; do not turn the three listed stages into a three-mark card while claiming the original task has three marks.
flags.status: recorded; do not propagate unverified source wording into learner material

flags.issue: 2023 P2 Q5(c) frames adaptations as tropical-rainforest features, then includes thick fleshy stems; the report response concerns water storage.
flags.handling: Use unambiguous original region/adaptation examples. Verify the selected plant’s ecology before teaching a broad regional rule.
flags.status: recorded; do not propagate unverified source wording into learner material

flags.issue: 2024 P2 Q5(a)(iv) asks for a feature on Skeleton Coast Park; the report suggests Sossusvlei or Cape Cross.
flags.handling: Do not treat this as a reliable geographic location statement. Check the figure and a primary map before producing a worked example.
flags.status: recorded; do not propagate unverified source wording into learner material

flags.issue: 2020 P2 Q1(b)(iv) requests gradient but says to give the answer in metres; the report calculation ends in a ratio.
flags.handling: Teach equal-unit inputs and the gradient ratio; do not label the ratio as a distance.
flags.status: recorded; do not propagate unverified source wording into learner material
